newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms buy 105,000 tonnes of corn.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms buy 105,000 tonnes of corn.

text.p: South Korea's Korea Corn Processing Industry Association (KOCOPIA) and Samyang Genex Co Ltd bought a total of 105,000 tonnes of corn from Cargill through private negotiations, traders said on Wednesday.
Traders said the purchases were made on Monday.
They said KOCOPIA bought 52,500 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn at $147.50 a tonne C&F with arrival for July 20 to the western port of Inchon.
Samyang Genex also bought another 52,500 tonnes at $147.75 a tonne C&F if sourced from the U.S., or $145 a tonne C&F if sourced from Argentina with seller's option.
Arrival was set for August 10 to the ports of Pusan and Ulsan.
